clashmac.name: ClashMac 27.1.4
clashmac.body:
### 性能提升
- 修复海量规则下搜索过滤、退格及页面切换时的卡死问题
- 修复大量连接历史下持续开启面板导致的 CPU 偏高与内存异常占用
- 降低概览页面及后台常驻时的磁盘读写频率

### 系统适配与体验优化
- 修复日志等级未本地化翻译的问题，并加宽筛选下拉框避免文字截断
- 补全智能旁路位置权限指引、连接状态标签等文案的简体中文翻译，消除中英文混杂
- 适配新版 macOS 权限机制，解决无法识别当前 Wi-Fi 名称导致智能旁路失效的问题
- 修复新系统下流量图表数值文字与内容重叠的显示问题
- 简化侧边栏列表，引擎入口聚合

### 指纹浏览器
- 自动根据节点 IP 归属地对齐时区、语言及 User-Agent，防止指纹泄漏
- 支持多环境参数隔离与专属节点配置，面板与菜单栏均可一键极速启停
- 扩展一次安装全环境通用，支持粘贴 Chrome 商店链接或 ID 快捷安装更新
- 启动即显内置主页，直观展示网络连通性、出口 IP 与快捷扩展入口

### ClashMac CLI
- 新增超短指令别名 `cm`（通过设置面板重装或运行 `cm install` 激活）
- 提供 `cm fp list / launch / stop` 快速管理指纹环境
- 提供 `cm fp goto / shot / eval / cookie` 等 CDP 浏览器自动化调试指令

#### 反馈

* **功能手册**：查阅 [正式版发布日志](https://github.com/666OS/ClashMac/releases/latest) 或 [用户手册](https://clashmac.app/guide/) 了解核心功能
* **问题反馈**：如遇运行异常，请提交至 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/666OS/ClashMac/issues) 或关注 [Telegram 频道](https://t.me/Pinched666)

polaris.name: v1.0.0
polaris.body:
# Polaris 1.0.0

基于 Tauri 2 + React 的跨平台代理客户端，内置 sing-box 内核，开箱即用。
A cross-platform proxy client built on Tauri 2 and React, shipping with the sing-box core built in.

---

## 亮点 / Highlights

### 订阅与协议 · Subscriptions and protocols

- 四种订阅格式共用同一套节点模型：分享链接、sing-box JSON、Clash YAML、Xray JSON。同一批节点换任意一种格式导入，识别结果一致。
- 覆盖 14 种出站类型与 17 种分享链接协议头，含 VLESS、VMess、Trojan、Shadowsocks、Hysteria / Hysteria2、TUIC、NaiveProxy、AnyTLS、Snell、SSH，以及 HTTP / HTTPS / SOCKS5 代理；代理凭据可选，匿名代理不会被拒。
- 订阅创建是原子操作，中途失败可恢复，不留半成品状态。

<sub>Four subscription formats map onto one node model — share links, sing-box JSON, Clash YAML and Xray JSON — so the same nodes import identically whichever format they arrive in. 14 outbound types and 17 share-link schemes are supported, including VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, Hysteria/Hysteria2, TUIC, NaiveProxy, AnyTLS, Snell, SSH and plain HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5 proxies, with credentials optional so anonymous proxies are accepted. Creating a subscription is atomic and recoverable.</sub>

### 代理与分流 · Proxying and routing

- TUN 全局接管与系统代理两种模式，按平台适配；Windows 上跟随网络变化自动重建。
- 规则分流内置 geosite / geoip 资源，支持自定义规则集与应用级分流（按进程指定走向）。
- DNS 并发竞速解析，FakeIP 与真实解析并存，减少首包延迟。
- 节点故障自动切换：连续检测到当前出口不通才动手，切换走管理 API 热切、不重启内核，切完回读自证。
- 换不动时会明说：候选都需要重启才能切过去时，界面上报一次，不会静默空转。

<sub>Both TUN-level capture and system-proxy mode, adapted per platform, with automatic rebuild on Windows network changes. Rule-based routing ships with geosite/geoip resources and supports custom rule sets plus per-application policy. DNS resolution races resolvers concurrently, with FakeIP alongside real resolution. Failover only acts after the current exit fails repeatedly; the switch goes through the management API without restarting the core, and reads the result back to prove it took effect. When every candidate would need a core restart, the app says so once instead of retrying silently.</sub>

### 组网 · Mesh networking

- 内置 WireGuard 与 Tailscale 端点，可直接把设备接入自有网络。
- 支持 Taildrop 文件传输。
- 只走内网的组网出口不参与故障切换判定——那个内网只有这条隧道到得了，换节点换不来它。首页改为直接显示这类隧道的健康状态。

<sub>Built-in WireGuard and Tailscale endpoints let a device join your own network directly, and Taildrop file transfer is supported. A mesh exit that only reaches a private network is left out of failover judgement, since no other node can reach that network anyway; the home screen reports such a tunnel's health directly instead.</sub>

### 观测 · Observability

- 实时连接列表、流量统计与图表、按主机与规则的命中排行。
- 流媒体解锁检测。
- 应用内日志页，日志级别可调。

<sub>A live connection list, traffic statistics and charts, per-host and per-rule hit rankings, streaming-unlock detection, and an in-app log page with adjustable level.</sub>

### 测速 · Speed testing

- 测速使用独立的临时内核，不打扰正在运行的主内核。
- 临时内核按固定就绪预算分批启动，单批上限 142 个 NaiveProxy 出站；每批的开始与就绪都会上报进度。
- 测速期间内核日志不再冲刷界面日志环，警告及以上照常保留。

<sub>Speed tests run in a separate temporary core so the live core is untouched. That core starts in batches sized to a fixed readiness budget — at most 142 NaiveProxy outbounds per batch — and each batch reports both its start and its readiness. Core logs no longer flush the UI log ring during a test; warnings and above still come through.</sub>

### 运行时可靠性 · Runtime reliability

- 内核经特权 helper 拉起；每个 spawn 请求都必须声明 stdio 处置，子进程输出全程有人读，管道写满不会再把内核卡死。
- 主内核就绪门按配置规模计算，而不是固定墙钟：固定开销 + 每节点解析 + 每个 NaiveProxy 出站构造 Chromium Cronet 引擎的代价，再乘安全系数。
- 陈旧内核清扫不会误杀仍在途的内核。
- 内核可在线更新与热切换，切换失败自动回退。

<sub>The core is launched through a privileged helper. Every spawn request must declare how it handles stdio and a child's output is always drained, so a full pipe can no longer wedge the core. The main core's readiness gate is sized from the config it starts — fixed cost, plus per-node parsing, plus the Chromium Cronet engine each NaiveProxy outbound constructs, times a safety factor — rather than a fixed wall clock. The stale-core sweep no longer kills cores still in flight. Cores can be updated and hot-swapped, with automatic rollback on failure.</sub>

### 界面 · Interface

- 五种语言：简体中文、繁體中文、English、Русский、فارسی。
- 深色 / 浅色主题，托盘常驻，应用内自动更新。

<sub>Five languages — Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Russian and Persian — with dark and light themes, a persistent tray presence and in-app auto-update.</sub>

---

## 下载 / Downloads

| 平台 Platform | 文件 File |
|---|---|
| Windows x64 | `Polaris_1.0.0_x64-win-setup.exe` |
| Windows 免安装 Portable | `polaris-portable-v1.0.0.zip` |
| macOS Apple Silicon | `Polaris_1.0.0_aarch64-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS Intel | `Polaris_1.0.0_x64-mac-x64.dmg` |
| Linux deb | `Polaris_1.0.0_amd64.deb` |
| Linux AppImage | `Polaris_1.0.0_amd64.AppImage` |

校验和见 `SHA256SUMS`。macOS 首次运行若被拦，执行 `xattr -cr /Applications/Polaris.app`。

<sub>Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS`. On macOS, if the first launch is blocked, run `xattr -cr /Applications/Polaris.app`.</sub>

# Changelog

Version 1.4.39 (2026-09-02 UTC)

## Changes since v1.4.35

All significant changes in this version are documented here.

### Changes

- Added a connect on launch option, and OneBox now starts in the background when launched at login.
- Combined TUN, system proxy and manual proxy into a single proxy mode setting, with the port alongside it.
- Updated sing-box version to v1.14.0.
- Updated JavaScript and Rust dependencies.

## 自 v1.4.35 以来的变更

本版本的所有重要变更将记录于此。

### 变更

- 更新 JavaScript 与 Rust 依赖。
- 新增启动后自动连接选项，开机启动时改为在后台启动。
- TUN、系统代理与手动代理合并为一处「代理模式」设置，端口也在同一处调整。
- 更新 sing-box 版本至 v1.14.0。


---

>
> Use development and beta versions only if you are aware of the potential risks.

singboard-for-mac.name: Singboard macOS Build (20260627-121223)
singboard-for-mac.body:
### 编译信息
- **分支**: `ForMac`
- **提交号**: `f6c9f44`
- **编译时间**: `20260627-121223`
- **编译目标**: arm64=true / x86_64=true

### 下载说明
| 文件 | 适用机型 |
|------|----------|
| `Singboard-macos-arm64-*.zip` | Apple Silicon（M1/M2/M3/M4） |
| `Singboard-macos-x86_64-*.zip` | Intel Mac |

### 使用说明
1. 【重要】软件运行必须依赖 sing-box 配置中 experimental 的 clash_api ，否则会运行异常，所以如果你没有配置，会自动覆写以下 experimental.clash_api，如果你配置了，则不会覆写。
```
"experimental": {
  "clash_api": {
    "external_controller": "127.0.0.1:9090",
    "external_ui": "ui"
  }
}
```
2. 根据机型下载对应 zip，解压后将 `Singboard.app` 拖入应用程序文件夹，然后打开终端，执行以下命令
【**每次**替换 `Singboard.app` **都需要执行**，不执行会提示文件损坏，无法打开/运行】
```
xattr -cr /Applications/Singboard.app
```
3. 前往 [sing-box releases](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/releases) 下载对应架构内核（arm64 或 amd64）
4. 解压后改名为 `sing-box`，放入工作目录（与 `config.json` 同级）
5. 首次启动核心时会弹出一次管理员密码框（用于安装特权 Helper），之后无需再次输入

### 【重要更新说明】
### 【重要更新说明】
### 【重要更新说明】
若已经安装使用过 singboard for mac ，替换新版 **singboard** 时 **必须：**
1. 点击【停止核心】
2. 设置中点击【卸载服务】
3. 顶部菜单栏右键点击 singboard 图标，选择退出。即：完全退出 singboard 
4. 最后再对 **应用程序** 里面的 **singboard.app** 进行替换操作。

clashbar.name: ClashBar 0.3.3
clashbar.body:
## 更新内容

![macOS](https://img.shields.io/badge/macOS-Supported-000000?style=flat-square&logo=apple) ![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Release-v0.3.3-10B981?style=flat-square) ![Core](https://img.shields.io/badge/Core-Mihomo-6366f1?style=flat-square)

> 本次更新集中在 **内核日志洪泛治理与菜单栏快捷键可用性**：修复 mihomo TUN 句柄失效后日志刷屏导致 ClashBar 内存涨到 3.2 GB、CPU 占用 230% 的问题，在日志管道源头加入限流与重复折叠；同时修复菜单命令状态冻结（`⌘E` 永久灰掉）和大写快捷键被隐式附加 `⇧` 的问题，补齐 `⌃⌘1/2/3` 模式切换，并为所有快捷键操作补上状态栏横幅反馈。此外菜单栏图标在 TUN 模式下有了独立形态，代理页新增延迟历史显示开关，文档站也上线了自动生成的更新日志页面。

### 📝 更新日志 (Changelog)

**✨ 新增功能 (New Features)**

- ![Feature](https://img.shields.io/badge/Feature-10B981?style=flat-square) **模式切换快捷键**：新增 `⌃⌘1` / `⌃⌘2` / `⌃⌘3` 分别切换到 Rule / Global / Direct 模式，内核不可用时自动置灰。
- ![Feature](https://img.shields.io/badge/Feature-10B981?style=flat-square) **快捷键操作横幅反馈**：菜单栏快捷键在面板关闭时触发也会给出确认——系统代理开关、TUN 开关、模式切换、内核启动/重启/停止、复制终端代理命令成功后都会弹出状态栏横幅，不再出现「按了没反应」的错觉。
- ![Feature](https://img.shields.io/badge/Feature-10B981?style=flat-square) **菜单栏 TUN 图标**：新增 BrandTun 品牌图标，内核运行且 TUN 开启时替换为 TUN 形态图标，一眼区分当前是否走 TUN；缺图时回退到运行图标，避免品牌图与 SF Symbol 互跳。
- ![Feature](https://img.shields.io/badge/Feature-10B981?style=flat-square) **延迟历史显示开关**：代理组标题栏新增开关，可在「最近 4 次延迟信号条」与「仅最新一次延迟」之间切换，状态本地持久化；代理组行与节点弹窗同步生效。
- ![Feature](https://img.shields.io/badge/Feature-10B981?style=flat-square) **文档站更新日志页**：文档站新增 Changelog 页面，直接解析仓库 `CHANGELOG.md` 生成版本时间线，无需手工同步两份内容。

**🚀 优化改进 (Improvements)**

- ![Optimize](https://img.shields.io/badge/Optimize-3B82F6?style=flat-square) **移除「重新加载配置」菜单项**：删除快捷操作菜单中的重载配置入口与 `⌘R` 快捷键，配置变更已由文件监听自动处理，文档同步更新。
- ![Optimize](https://img.shields.io/badge/Optimize-3B82F6?style=flat-square) **状态栏渲染去重简化**：删除与 `MenuBarDisplay` 逐字段重复的 `StatusItemRenderKey`，渲染键直接复用显示模型，仅在使用品牌图标时忽略 symbolName，减少一层等价类型。

irbox.name: IRBox v1.0.2
irbox.body:
## IRBox Release v1.0.2

Automated release of IRBox client application.

### What's Changed
- Built for multiple platforms: Windows, macOS, and Linux
- Includes sing-box and xray-core executables
- Tauri-based desktop application
- Added geoip.dat and geosite.dat for enhanced routing

### Assets
This release includes installers/packages for:
- Windows (x86_64 MSVC/GNU and ARM64 MSVC)
- macOS (Intel and Apple Silicon)
- Linux (x86_64 and ARM64)

### System Requirements
- Windows 10 or later
- macOS 10.15 or later
- Linux with glibc 2.17 or later

## Installing & Running IRBox on macOS

### 1. Install IRBox
1. Double-click the downloaded `.dmg` file.
2. Move **IRBox** into the **Applications** folder.
3. Open it from Applications like any standard Mac app.

> ℹ️ IRBox starts in **Proxy Mode** by default — no additional permissions are required.

---

## Enabling TUN Mode (Routes All Traffic)

When switching to **TUN Mode**, IRBox needs elevated system privileges to manage network traffic.

You can enable it in one of the following ways:

### Method 1 — Grant Admin Access from Inside the App
1. Launch **IRBox**
2. Navigate to **Settings → VPN Mode**
3. Choose **TUN**
4. Click **Run as Administrator**

### Method 2 — Start via Terminal
Use the command below:

```bash
sudo /Applications/IRBox.app/Contents/MacOS/IRBox
```

### Installation
Download the appropriate package for your platform and follow the installation instructions.

results.description:
One app. Three networking engines. Your rules.

Everywhere is the smartest way to take charge of how your iPhone and iPad talk to the internet. Bring your own configuration, pick the engine you trust, and flip a switch. That's it.


THREE TRUSTED ENGINES, UNDER ONE ROOF

Most apps lock you into a single way of doing things. Everywhere is different. Inside, you'll find Xray, sing-box, and mihomo — three of the most respected open-source networking engines in the world — all neatly packed into one beautiful app. Switch between them whenever you like, with a single tap.


BRING YOUR CONFIG, IN A SECOND

Type one in by hand, drop in a file from your device, or paste a link and let the app fetch it for you. Your setups stay neatly organized — each engine keeps its own list, so nothing ever gets mixed up or tangled together.


A REAL EDITOR, RIGHT IN YOUR POCKET

Tweak your configurations with a thoughtful, well-crafted editor that actually understands what you're working with. Crisp syntax colors, line numbers, and a clean layout make every change a pleasure.


SEE YOUR TRAFFIC, LIVE

A built-in dashboard lets you watch your network in real time. View live traffic, switch between proxy groups, and inspect routing rules — all without ever leaving the app.


YOUR FILES, IN THE RIGHT PLACE

Drop in your geo databases, cache files, certificates and anything else your engines need. Everywhere automatically tucks them away where each engine expects to find them. No guesswork. No fiddling.


PRIVATE BY DESIGN

No tracking. No analytics. No ads. No accounts to create. Your configurations live on your device — and only your device. The way it should be.


OPEN AND TRANSPARENT

Everywhere is built on top of the open-source projects you already know and trust, and the entire app is open-source too. Nothing to hide. Everything to gain.


Whether you're a curious tinkerer, a seasoned power user, or simply someone who wants more control over the connection in their pocket — Everywhere gives you the tools, gets out of your way, and lets you do things your way.

Everywhere. The internet, your way.

Connect Now 是一款面向高要求用户打造的专业级网络加速与代理工具，采用开源 Mihomo 内核，提供高性能、多协议、强规则的转发与分流能力。
我们对 iOS 端体验进行了深度优化，在保证稳定与低资源占用的同时，带来细腻而强大的可视化与配置管理。
核心特性
高性能内核：集成 Mihomo 1.19.20，支持 HTTP/HTTPS、SOCKS5、Shadowsocks、VMess/VLESS、Trojan、Hysteria/Hysteria2、TUIC、WireGuard 等主流协议，满足多样化场景。

配置全生命周期管理：展示本地 YAML 配置文件，支持新建、编辑、重命名、删除、复制；可在多配置间一键切换并以所选配置启动内核；启动前自动校验，避免无效配置导致的失败。
多源配置获取：支持本地编辑、远程 URL 下载以及二维码扫描导入；自动记录订阅链接，并在配置列表中提供一键刷新更新；支持错误提示与进度反馈。
设置中心：可视化调整日志等级（debug/info/warning/error/silent）、IPv6 总开关、Geodata 资源地址（geoip/geosite/mmdb）、External Controller/Secret 等，所见即所得。
启动错误直达：网络扩展与主 App 间通过共享容器传递错误信息，出现解析/启动问题时以弹窗直达提醒，定位更高效。
日志系统：支持实时查看、刷新与清空；同时处理文件与内存缓冲，清空后无需重启即可继续写入与展示；支持行级着色与统计信息。
iOS 原生体验：基于 SwiftUI 与 Network Extension 打造，连接按钮动效、状态图标、过渡动画与统一圆角风格，既轻盈又稳定；首次使用智能提示 VPN 权限，流程清晰。
稳定与低占用：优化统计拉取频率、内存与文件 IO；在网络扩展的资源限制下仍保持顺滑与耐久运行。
典型场景
日常稳定代理：一键连接、自动分流，兼具性能与省心。
多环境切换：工作/家庭/出行多配置快速切换，所选即用。
订阅管理：远程订阅导入＋一键刷新，随时保持最新。
调试与排错：实时日志＋启动错误弹窗，问题定位更直接。

results.description:
Tunna - The Proxy Powerhouse for iOS

Tunna isn't your average proxy app. It's a meticulously crafted tool for iOS, built on the rock-solid Xray Core and fully V2Ray compatible. If you're looking for deep control over your network traffic and demand performance, you're in the right place. Tunna speaks your language, supporting VLess, VMess, Trojan, and Shadowsocks out of the box.

Heads up: Tunna is a client. You'll need your own proxy servers to get going.

⌘ Granular Traffic Control, Your Way.

This is where Tunna shines. Forget basic on/off proxying. We're talking surgical precision:
• Route by domain names, IPs (CIDR-aware), or specific ports.
• Dive deeper with Layer 7 (HTTP/HTTPS) and Layer 4 (TCP/UDP) protocol-based rules.
• Set up intricate routing scenarios that just work.

⌘ iOS On-Demand: Smart & Seamless.

Tunna plays nice with iOS. Its On-Demand feature means you set your target domains, and Tunna fires up the right connection automatically when you hit them. No manual switching, just intelligent, background connectivity.

⌘ Live Node Health: No More Guesswork.

Wondering about node performance? Tunna's integrated RTT checker is always on, giving you a real-time pulse on latency and health across your configured nodes. You see what's fast, what's not, instantly.

⌘ Zero-Downtime Config: Uninterrupted Flow.

Tired of tunnel restarts every time you tweak a setting? Tunna lets you change nodes, update rules, and modify configurations on the fly. Your connection stays live. Your workflow stays smooth.

⌘ Multi-Node Muscle: Beyond Basic Split Tunneling.

This is where things get interesting. Tunna allows you to bind different rules to different nodes, simultaneously.
• Implement advanced split tunneling with ease.
• Go further and split traffic across multiple nodes based on your rules. Stream through one, browse through another – all at the same time. It’s about giving you the power to route traffic exactly how you envision.

⌘ Battery-Friendly by Design.

A powerful proxy shouldn't kill your battery. Tunna is optimized for efficiency, especially during device sleep. It respects system states, so you get the power without the drain.

⌘ Management, Simplified.

Juggling multiple proxy managed lists? Tunna provides a clean interface to manage and switch between them effortlessly.

Tunna is for those who need more than just a toggle switch. It’s for users who want to command their connection, optimize their routes, and demand a stable, flexible, and efficient proxy experience on iOS. If that sounds like you, give Tunna a spin.
